description: This file implements FastAPI endpoints related to spend management, including spend key retrieval, user spend, tags, global activity, spend reports, spend calculation, and spend logs. It exposes various API routes for querying spend data, handling authorization, and aggregating information from a PostgreSQL database via Prisma client. The code heavily relies on FastAPI dependency injection, SQL queries, and in-memory utilities for provider and model handling.
